paper.central_claim: BoT 用 meta-buffer 存放从各任务求解过程蒸馏出的高层思维模板，对每个问题检索并实例化模板，并由 buffer-manager 随任务求解动态更新缓冲区，从而在 10 个推理任务上提升准确率、效率(仅 12% 多查询成本)与鲁棒性。
paper.title: Buffer of Thoughts: Thought-Augmented Reasoning with Large Language Models

evidence.quote: If we initialize an empty meta-buffer or encounter a problem without a proper thought-template, the distilled thought-templates will be directly stored in the meta-buffer.
evidence.support_explanation: Unmatched solutions become persistent templates without an explicit correctness gate.

evidence.quote: \text{Max}(\text{Sim}(f(D_{T_{new}}),\{f(D_{T_{i}})\}_{i=0}^{n}))<\delta.
evidence.support_explanation: Admission uses embedding novelty, not measured marginal utility.

evidence.quote: In this ablation study, we divide the entire process into four rounds. In each round, we randomly sample 50 questions from each benchmark and conduct reasoning. In the subsequent round, we continue to randomly sample another 50 questions from each benchmark.
evidence.support_explanation: Later rounds use earlier retained templates; distinctness/deduplication across rounds is not explicitly guaranteed.

evidence.quote: In contrast, the model without the buffer-manager fails to exhibit an upward trend.
evidence.support_explanation: Author-reported manager-off comparison; curve values are not in the fixed text.

evidence.quote: BoT requires only 12% of the cost of multi-query methods
evidence.support_explanation: Relative inference cost claim, not a full construction/maintenance ledger.

evidence.quote: this evaluation process 10 times and take the average accuracy as the success rate of different methods on each benchmark.
evidence.support_explanation: Repeated evaluation average is reported, but not cross-buffer/search variance or intervals.

evidence.quote: We randomly sample 1000 examples from various benchmarks as a test subset and evaluate different methods on this subset.
evidence.support_explanation: Sample size for robustness evaluation, not all main benchmark denominators.

evidence.quote: In contrast, our BoT directly retrieves a thought-template in code format, thus a program is instantiated to traverse combinations of numbers and symbols, thereby eliminating the need to build the reasoning structure from scratch.
evidence.support_explanation: Program execution/enumeration is a substantive alternative explanation to abstract thought alone.

evidence.quote: we choose six different benchmarks, each sampled with 100 distinct tasks. We update the meta-buffer from scratch, and after completing all sampled tasks, we display the number of derived thought-templates.
evidence.support_explanation: Buffer-building procedure and denominators, not frozen unseen-category evaluation.

evidence.quote: to store a series of informative high-level thoughts
evidence.support_explanation: 中心对象：meta-buffer 存放高层"思维模板"(thought-template)，非权重的持久状态。

evidence.quote: they neglect to derive general and high-level guidelines or thoughts from previously-completed tasks, which are informative for improving efficiency and accuracy when solving similar problems.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者 gap：已有单/多查询推理不从已完成任务中提炼高层指引。

evidence.quote: but it only focuses on textual comprehension/generation instead of general reasoning problems.
evidence.support_explanation: 对最近邻 Thought-Retriever 的差异化论述(仅文本理解/生成)。

evidence.quote: If we initialize an empty meta-buffer or encounter a problem without a proper thought-template, the distilled thought-templates will be directly stored in the meta-buffer.
evidence.support_explanation: 写入规则一：无合适模板即直接存入，未提到正确性校验。

evidence.quote: Otherwise, it means the meta-buffer has already possessed the necessary knowledge to solve this task and does not need to perform the update.
evidence.support_explanation: 写入规则二：与现有模板描述相似度高于阈值则不更新（仅按新颖性去重）。

evidence.quote: To extract a general though-template, we propose a three-step approach:
evidence.support_explanation: 模板由 LLM 对"问题+自己的解答"做三步蒸馏（任务概述、解题步骤、通用答案模板）。

evidence.quote: by calculating the embedding similarity between the description
evidence.support_explanation: 检索：问题蒸馏结果与模板描述的 embedding 相似度，阈值 δ(0.5~0.7)判定是否新任务。

evidence.quote: we prepare three general coarse-grained thought-templates for utilization.
evidence.support_explanation: 新任务时回退到三种预置的粗粒度模板（预置来源与是否人工撰写未说明）。

evidence.quote: our buffer-manager can ensure permanent advancements in accuracy, efficiency, and robustness for LLM-based reasoning.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者主张：buffer-manager 带来"永久"增益——需留存收益证据。

evidence.quote: Our BoT significantly outperforms other methods on all tasks, especially on general reasoning problems.
evidence.support_explanation: 主结果主张。
Game of 24：BoT 82.4，ToT 74.0，Meta Prompting 67.0（单次数值，无区间）。
Checkmate-in-One 行：PAL 10.8 … Meta Prompting 57.2，BoT 86.4。

evidence.quote: 11% on Game of 24, 20% on Geometric Shapes and 51% on Checkmate-in-One
evidence.support_explanation: 摘要的提升幅度写法为 11%/20%/51%。

evidence.quote: 23% on Game of 24, 20% on Geometric Shapes and 51% on Checkmate-in-One
evidence.support_explanation: 同一比较在正文写作 23%（相对 Meta Prompting 67.0→82.4 为相对提升）；摘要 11% 与正文不一致，且混用相对/绝对口径。

evidence.quote: import chess def find_checkmate_move
evidence.support_explanation: Checkmate-in-One 的"思维模板"是调用 python-chess 库的代码；主要基线(GPT-4/CoT/ToT 等)无同等库/代码工具，结果可比性受混杂。

evidence.quote: Notably, our BoT requires only 12% of the cost of multi-query methods (e.g., tree of thoughts and meta-prompting) on average.
evidence.support_explanation: 效率主张：成本以推理时间衡量（Figure 3，数值仅在图中）。

evidence.quote: we repeat this evaluation process 10 times and take the average accuracy as the success rate of different methods on each benchmark.
evidence.support_explanation: 鲁棒性的"success rate"=10 次重复的平均准确率，仅图中给出，无离散度。

evidence.quote: In this ablation study, we divide the entire process into four rounds. In each round, we randomly sample 50 questions from each benchmark and conduct reasoning.
evidence.support_explanation: 留存实验设计：四轮、每轮从各基准随机取 50 题，缓冲区随处理的题目增长——构建流与评测流同源。

evidence.quote: Therefore, we can observe that the accuracy of BoT steadily improves with each round.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者报告：带 buffer-manager 时准确率逐轮上升（Figure 9，数值仅在图中）。

evidence.quote: In contrast, the model without the buffer-manager fails to exhibit an upward trend.
evidence.support_explanation: 对照：关闭 buffer-manager 无上升趋势（有留存物消融的设计，但数据仅在图）。

evidence.quote: We update the meta-buffer from scratch, and after completing all sampled tasks, we display the number of derived thought-templates.
evidence.support_explanation: 缓冲区可从零开始、由被评测任务本身增长。

evidence.quote: Besides, if our BoT initializes the meta-buffer with a weaker model, the quality of the derived thought-templates may be suboptimal due to the weaker model’s limited reasoning ability and instruction-following capability.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认模板质量依赖蒸馏模型能力。

evidence.quote: For the fair comparisons with previous methods, we use GPT-4 as the base model of our BoT, including the main experiment and the ablation study
evidence.support_explanation: 主实验与消融均为 GPT-4；其他基座仅在分析中。

evidence.quote: thus a program is instantiated to traverse combinations of numbers and symbols
evidence.support_explanation: Game of 24 用实例化出的程序遍历组合，即把任务转为可执行程序求解（与 PAL/代码求解同类）。

evidence.support_explanation: Distillation input is the distilled problem and the model's own solution; nothing in §3.3 conditions insertion on correctness or an external check (insertion gate is novelty only, eq. 5).

G.reason: Opus sides with son55. Gap (no reuse of high-level guidelines from completed tasks) is sourced and Thought-Retriever/analogical/meta-prompting are named, but the closest experience-abstraction neighbours (insight-extraction memories, Reflexion-style memory, skill libraries) are neither discussed nor compared; multi-query cost is generic background.

M.reason: Opus sides with son55. Distil→retrieve→instantiate is concrete, but the key assumption — that a template distilled from a single, unverified solution is reusable guidance — is weak (opus:O01), and no prediction distinguishes template abstraction from raw-case retrieval or plain program delegation.

X.reason: Opus sides with son55. Retrieval threshold, novelty rule and fallback templates are described, but insertion has no correctness gate, no retirement/versioning, and the buffer state/initialisation used for the main Table 1 runs is not specified — a key operating condition left unclear (2 anchor). sol's own reason lists the same gaps.

E.measurement.reason: Opus sides with son55. Verifiable tasks, but Table 1 evaluation-set sizes are not reported, the Sonnet-writing metric is unspecified, and headline deltas are internally inconsistent (abstract 11% vs §4.1 23% on Game of 24). python-chess comparability is scored under E.causality (A2).

E.causality.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. Distiller-off, meta-buffer-off and manager-off ablations exist; executable templates (python-chess, enumeration) and extra calls are not matched in baselines; no raw-case retrieval control. v1 figure values (opus:O03) confirm direction, do not lift this.

E.holdout.reason: Both seats 1; re-checked. Rounds draw new questions from the same benchmarks the buffer is built from; no overlap check, no frozen-store held-out set; main-run buffer construction relative to test items unstated.

E.statistics.reason: Both seats 1; re-checked. Ten repeated 1000-sample evaluations reported as means only; Table 1 single values, sizes missing, no intervals.

E.cost.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. Relative inference time and the '12% of cost' claim (time-based) and a component time split are reported; no token/$ ledger, buffer construction not amortised, not budget-matched.
